annotations.title: Find a club near a place

description: Find running and cycling clubs near a place, e.g. best running club to join in Fourways, beginner cycling group near Sandton. Lists approved clubs and organisers on Windline (cycling) and RunFast (running) nearest first, with their weekly sessions, whether beginners are welcome, whether anyone can join (Open to anyone) or it's members only, their pace groups, their next session with its weather, the club's own links page when it has one, and a Join link to the club's page. Set beginners for "beginner friendly", "new to running", "for beginners"; set open for "open to anyone", "anyone can join", "no membership", "don't need to be a member". Only clubs that have added their area show; never a person. Say what each club chose to share, and nothing more. For coaches or personal trainers, use find_coaches.

beginners.description: true when the user wants a beginner-friendly club ("beginner friendly", "new to cycling").

km.description: How far from the place, in km (1 to 100). Leave it out for 25 km.

open.description: true for only clubs open to anyone (no membership needed): "open to anyone", "anyone can join", "no membership".

place.description: The suburb, town or city, as the user said it, e.g. "Fourways", "Durban North", "Cape Town".

sport.description: cycling or running, or one sport: road, gravel, mtb, road-run, trail-run, tours (multi-day tours). Leave it out for both.

units.description: Pass the asker's units: imperial for users in the US, UK road distances, Liberia or Myanmar, or when they ask in miles/°F; otherwise metric.

name: find_clubs

outputSchema.description: Clubs and organisers near a place, nearest first.

add_club.description: Where a club that isn't listed asks to be added: { cycling (Windline's page application), running (RunFast's Add your club) }.

app.description: windline, or runfast when every row is a running club or event.

clubs.description: Nearest first: id, app, name, kind (club or organiser), url (its page), join (Join: the page, sign-in in the same step), photo, km, area, sports, sessions (one line), beginners_welcome, open_to_all (true: Open to anyone, false: Members only, null: not said), links ({ url, biotree }: the club's own links page, or null), pace_groups, who_for, next ({ start, place, kind, weather, weather_basis: forecast or typical }).

error.description: When the call failed: what went wrong, in words for the user.

message.description: When view is "none": what to tell the user (no match, not live yet, a question back).

open.description: Only clubs open to anyone (no membership needed).

place.description: The place searched, as found on the map.

signup.description: Without a sign-in: { label, url } to make a free Windline or RunFast account (?ref=mcp).

sponsor_line.description: The line every answer ends with: who brings livedot's live tracking free.

sport.description: The sport asked for, or null for all.

view.description: What this answer is; "none" when there is nothing to show (see message).

title: Find a club near a place
